meta.name: init-deep
meta.description: Initializes a hierarchical AGENTS.md knowledge base for a project. Use when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为项目生成分层说明文件,让 AI 编程助手读懂代码结构、命令与约定
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你希望 AI 助手在大型代码库里按目录逐步理解项目并遵循团队约定
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI agents to understand a large codebase by directory and follow team conventions

howto.what: 在项目里运行 /init-deep,它会扫描代码库并生成分层 AGENTS.md 文件(根目录加若干子目录),记录结构、查找位置、命令与约定,最后给出完成报告。
howto.when: 当仓库需要把结构、命令和约定写成 AGENTS.md 给 agent 用时触发;可用 --max-depth、--create-new 等参数调整。

say.text: 运行 /init-deep,给这个仓库生成 AGENTS.md
say.note: 会扫描仓库并生成分层知识库文件
先读现有文件,全部删除后重新生成
把目录深度限制为 2 层

howto.what_en: Running /init-deep in a project scans the repo and generates hierarchical AGENTS.md files (root plus scored subdirectories) covering structure, where to look, commands, and conventions, then prints a completion report.
howto.when_en: Use when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents; flags such as --max-depth and --create-new adjust the run.

say_en.text: Run /init-deep to generate AGENTS.md for this repo
say_en.note: Scans the repo and writes hierarchical knowledge files
Reads existing files, deletes all, then regenerates
